content: Hello! how can I help today?
I earned R&D tax credits but didn’t use them all. What happens to the rest?
Unused R&D credits can **carry forward for up to 20 years**. Use **Form 6765** to calculate and generate a carryforward schedule.
Do I need to elect the carryforward each year?
No election is needed. The unused portion automatically carries forward—they accumulate until used or expired.
Where do I record the credits each year?
Report current-year credits and any previous carryforward on **Form 3800**, line 2g and line 16 respectively, and include the carryforward schedule from Form 6765.
